ruleDefinitions.name: Security Software Discovery - MacOs
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects usage of system utilities (only grep for now) to discover security software discovery

sequences.query: process_path = "\/usr\/bin\/grep" AND ((process_command_line = RGX(".*nessusd.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*santad.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*CbDefense.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*falcond.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*td\\-agent.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*packetbeat.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*filebeat.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*auditbeat.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*osqueryd.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*BlockBlock.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*LuLu.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*Little.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*Snitch.*")))
